fusions.name: Thrown and Fetched
fusions.desc: Throws your trowel, which deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill fetches one back.

fusions.name: Pack at the Gate
fusions.desc: A shove outward that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Hold the Threshold
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Porter's Mastiff
fusions.desc: A bonded mastiff guards you. Every 1.2 seconds it bites an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
